#include <vector>

int main() {
    int w, m;
    std::cin >> w >> m;

    std::vector<int> digits;
    while (m > 0) {
        digits.push_back(m % w);
        m /= w;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < digits.size(); ++i) {
        int cur = digits[i];
        if (cur == 0 || cur == 1 || cur == -1) {
            continue;
        } else if (cur == w - 1) {
            digits[i] = cur - w;
            if (i + 1 == digits.size()) {
                digits.push_back(0);
            }
            digits[i + 1] += 1;
        } else if (cur == w) {
            digits[i] = 0;
            if (i + 1 == digits.size()) {
                digits.push_back(0);
            }
            digits[i + 1] += 1;
        } else {
            std::cout << "NO" << std::endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    std::cout << "YES" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
